title: When angry
cue: The word that takes anger away
translation: I seek refuge with Allah from Satan, the outcast.

witnesses.name: shamela
witnesses.ref: Sahih al-Bukhari, al-Sultaniyya print, hadith 6115: https://shamela.ws/book/1681/9157

usage.evidence: Two men insulted each other, one red-faced with anger. The Prophet ﷺ said: I know a word which, if he said it, what he feels would leave him (al-Bukhari 6115).
